acceptance_criterion: Both directions (forward, reverse) of the EXACT domain-shift protocol (cal=marine/test=non-marine and reverse) must reach >= 0.88 observed coverage at the 0.90 target, using a Mondrian calibrator stratified by chloride-environment class.
fire1_summary: Naive per-class Mondrian: worse both directions (REJECTED). Conservative-floor Mondrian (per-class quantile clamped >= pooled): reverse 0.876307 -> 0.877389 (2433/2773), still 8 rows short of 2441. Coarse 2-class variant: identical result.

fire2_summary.structural_ceiling_proof: Exact accounting: reverse leg marine-calibration data (n=1043) has 6 of 8 chloride-environment classes at EXACTLY ZERO rows (alkali, organic_acid, other_acid, salt_other, sulfuric, water); only halide (928) and other (115) are nonzero. 2105 of 2773 (75.9%) nonmarine test rows fall in zero-cal classes and are PROVABLY forced to the pooled fallback quantile regardless of MIN_CLASS_N threshold or class granularity -- this closes off the hyperparameter space fire 1 left unexplored (lower MIN_CLASS_N cannot help: zero is zero at any threshold).
fire2_summary.reweighted_conformal_probe: Likelihood-ratio reweighted split conformal (Tibshirani et al 2019), run as a supplementary diagnostic (NOT a substitute for the pinned Mondrian mechanism): FAILED much worse (observed coverage 0.0638 vs floor 0.88). Domain classifier (logistic regression on covariates) achieves AUC=1.0 distinguishing marine-cal from nonmarine-test rows -- near-total positivity/overlap violation, same root cause as the ceiling proof. Confirms this is not a Mondrian-specific limitation: the reverse-direction covariate shift is severe enough that no calibration-side reweighting fix (of the two tried) can plausibly close the gap.
fire2_summary.verdict: CLAIM_REFUTED, repair_status=in_progress. Mondrian-by-chloride-class mechanism space now EXHAUSTIVELY shown incapable (empirically fire1 + analytically fire2).

recommendation_for_next_fire: Fire 3 is the FINAL permitted fire (max_fires=3): the re-scope hatch becomes available (len(fires)>=max_fires-1=2 satisfied once fire 2's ledger record lands).

STRONG RECOMMENDATION: invoke the re-scope hatch. Two independent calibration-side mechanisms (Mondrian stratification, likelihood-ratio reweighting) have now failed this exact acceptance floor, the second failing an order of magnitude worse due to a provable near-total covariate-support mismatch (76% of reverse-leg test rows in chloride classes with zero marine-calibration representation; domain-classifier AUC=1.0). Do not attempt a third calibration mechanism against a shift this severe -- diminishing information value.

Re-scope deliverable: report the per-environment-class coverage table (chloride_env_class x direction) as the new claim, stating plainly which classes have marine-calibration support and which do not, and which chloride classes in the deployed (nonmarine) population are and are not covered by any calibration mechanism tried. This is the honest, information-preserving outcome the campaign item's own hatch anticipates for exactly this failure mode.

Do not re-try naive per-class Mondrian, conservative-floor Mondrian (any granularity, any MIN_CLASS_N), or likelihood-ratio reweighting with the same domain-classifier design -- all now shown either insufficient or degenerate for this reverse leg.
